bodies: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center

exams.name: Merchant Mariner Credential
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Single credential book that consolidates all officer, rating and STCW endorsements a United States mariner holds.

exams.name: Merchant Mariner Medical Certificate
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Medical and physical fitness certificate required alongside the merchant mariner credential, based on the CG-719K examination.

exams.name: Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry captain licence allowing carriage of up to six paying passengers on uninspected vessels for inland, Great Lakes or near coastal routes.

exams.name: Ordinary Seaman Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry-level deck rating requiring no sea service, used as the starting endorsement for new mariners joining a vessel crew.

exams.name: Qualified Member of the Engine Department
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Engine rating covering oiler, fireman-watertender, junior engineer and refrigerating engineer roles, earned by sea service and examination.

exams.name: Rating Forming Part of a Navigational Watch
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW deck rating requiring assessed steering, lookout and watchkeeping competencies for service on seagoing vessels.

exams.name: Rating Forming Part of an Engineering Watch
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: STCW engine rating certifying competence to keep an engine room watch under the direction of a licensed engineer officer.

exams.name: Second Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Unlimited-tonnage deck licence above third mate, requiring additional sea service and Coast Guard examination modules.

exams.name: Ship's Cook Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Steward department endorsement requiring approved food safety training and sea service before a mariner may serve as ship cook.

exams.name: Tankerman-Assistant Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement allowing a mariner to assist in cargo transfers of oil or hazardous liquids under the supervision of a person in charge.

exams.name: Tankerman-Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement for licensed engineers supervising transfer of fuel oil and bunkering operations aboard tank vessels.

exams.name: Tankerman-PIC (Barge) Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Restricted tankerman endorsement covering cargo transfers on tank barges rather than self-propelled tank vessels.

exams.name: Tankerman-PIC Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Endorsement authorising a mariner to act as person in charge of transferring dangerous liquid or liquefied gas cargo.

exams.name: Third Assistant Engineer Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry unlimited engineering officer licence requiring extensive Coast Guard examinations in motor, steam, gas turbine and electrical plants.

exams.name: Third Mate Endorsement
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Entry unlimited deck officer licence for oceans service, examined across navigation, stability, cargo, safety and rules of the road.

exams.name: USCG Chart Plot Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Ten-question plotting module requiring 90 percent to pass, covering fixes, set and drift, courses to steer and estimated times of arrival.

exams.name: USCG Deck General Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Examination module on seamanship, marlinespike, ship construction, stability and deck operations for master level credentials.

exams.name: USCG Deck Safety Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Examination module covering firefighting, damage control, lifesaving equipment, pollution regulations and emergency procedures.

exams.name: USCG Navigation General Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Fifty-question module on aids to navigation, tides and currents, compass error, weather and publications, requiring 90 percent to pass.

exams.name: USCG Rules of the Road Exam Module
exams.body: U.S. Coast Guard National Maritime Center
exams.blurb: Module on International and Inland navigation rules, lights, shapes and sound signals requiring a 90 percent passing score.
